override._why: The first screen after loading is Load Profile with an empty list (from about 36-50 s); Start/A do nothing there. B goes back to LOAD PROFILE / NEW PROFILE, Down then A picks NEW PROFILE; the defaults accept the name wheel (Player) and go through the main menu and story intro into the first drive. The race is under way by about 70 s, and the next Start opens the pause menu's Sound page for the rest of the run, so from 64 s only A (accelerate) is pressed, every 4 s.
